`# The lending policy allows each member to hold five books at once.`

All 16 tests now pass. I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`:
- **`search.py`:** it imported from a nonexistent module. It now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment on line 3 and the tests say five. I changed it to 5.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies the two.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the book "Emma". I added it.
